answer: Reputation Beacon Freeze is the mechanism. Each agent broadcasts a beacon tied to its operator's shared infrastructure, and a detected sybil cluster freezes every identity routed through that operator's link. A flagged inlet to the same server quarantines all sibling wallets until the operator pays a per-identity revalidation fee plus lost access. Colluding operators thus face a meadow of dormant identities, each costing far more to revive than to spawn.
